name: the-strategist
description: Goal-refinement tasks targeting the-strategist member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the problem statement and nothing else for: 'ship the new dashboard soon'.
Reply with ONLY one success criterion and nothing else for: reduce checkout errors.
tasks.expectedOutput: A measurable criterion mentioning errors or checkout.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the top priority and nothing else for: fix the outage, then add dark mode, then refactor.
tasks.expectedOutput: The outage fix as top priority.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the scope boundary and nothing else for: a password-reset feature that must not touch billing.
Reply with ONLY 'API owners' or 'no one' and nothing else for: who approves a breaking API change?
